# Independent review assessment cases

`cases.json` contains specification, pre-execution, and results scenarios. It includes missing decisions, omitted defaults, extra arguments, environment overrides, changed inputs, altered criteria, incomplete execution evidence, false reviewer separation, stale reviews, paired comparison failures, protected work, and missing delegation.

For a forward test, supply the reviewer skill and a case's phase, approved facts, prepared material, and actual observations to a separate evaluator. Keep the expected result hidden until it returns an assessment. Preserve the actual response and assess whether it identifies the material issue, reports an appropriate outcome, and leaves unauthorized decisions with the user. Raw scenario snippets are assessment data. Loading this fixture must never execute them.

These are focused fictional scenarios. The compliant case assumes the stated complete fixture scope and provenance. It provides no approval for real work. Static tests validate the numerical and logical counterexamples and the consistency of the corpus. They do not substitute for an independent semantic assessment or a product project's required reviews.
